decisions.mark: states that the shipped mbedtls_config.h leaves BOTH threading macros undefined, so a default build defines neither
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` has `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` commented out. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also commented out. | WHY: The answer states the shipped config header leaves the threading macros (THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD) commented out, so a default build defines neither. || QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` has `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` commented out. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also commented out. | WHY: The answer states the shipped config header has the threading macros (THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD) commented out, so a default build defines neither. || QUOTE: `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` has `//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` commented out. `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also commented out. | WHY: The answer states that the shipped config header leaves THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD commented out, so a default build defines neither.
